_comment: Central domain routing on the dedicated nginx VM. Names are labels below lab.json's
domain; @ is the domain itself. Backend addresses are always taken from lab.json vms,
never from public DNS, to avoid proxy loops. TLS is passed through unchanged: the services
keep their own certificates and private keys. Publishing a route also requires the
corresponding lab.json published port to use targetVm: nginx.
OpenBao (vault) is not routed here: it binds logins and tokens to client addresses, and a
proxy would have to vouch for them. The firewall forwards it directly (lab.json).
Matrix media ports stay direct; only its HTTP and HTTPS entry points use nginx.
tcp: plain TCP passthrough inside the lab. 8448 carries Synapse's federation listener,
which serves only the openid resource: the LiveKit JWT service checks callers there, and
inside the lab matrix.<domain> resolves to nginx.
source "management": the route also enforces the management source policy: the configured PC
and the private lab network only, including connections arriving through another published
IP (RustFS, the firewall GUI, Rancher, Hubble UI and Airflow). The Kubernetes ingress is Traefik on
k8s-server (hostPort 443); it picks Rancher, Hubble UI or Airflow by host name and terminates
